name: popsicle
headline: Dengage.Framework: iOS Push Notifications
short_description: dEngage Customer Driven Marketing Platform (CDMP) helps you with a flexible data space that provides a relational database without boundaries and enables you to send personalized content via email, sms, mobile/web push channels.
author: whitehorse-technology

sections.overview:
Dengage.Framework is an iOS SDK that integrates with dEngage's Customer Driven Marketing Platform to manage push notifications and engagement tracking. The framework handles notification registration, sends open events to dEngage's infrastructure, and enables subscription event tracking. Built for iOS 10.0 and higher, it requires a dEngage Integration Key and iOS Push Certificate to function. Developers can install it via CocoaPods and leverage the framework's classes and functions to optimize push notification delivery and measure campaign performance.
Register iOS devices for push notifications in marketing campaigns
Track push notification open events and user engagement
Send subscription events to dEngage infrastructure
Integrate dEngage's CDMP with native iOS applications
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/whitehorse-technology/Dengage.Framework`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a marketing strategist using the dEngage Customer Driven Marketing Platform (CDMP). Create a personalized multi-channel campaign for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business. Use the following [DATA] to tailor content for email, SMS, and mobile/web push notifications. Ensure the campaign aligns with their customer segments and engagement history.
```
